name: rule-one-use-of-several
why: An ask for one of the uses a rule names is within it.

job.purpose:
Deliver a change as a pull request from branch discobox/<slug> into main of discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; push that branch (creating it with an empty --force-with-lease, and with --force-with-lease after a rebase), open and update the pull request, comment on it and reply to its reviews, and re-run its failed CI. Never push main or any other branch, delete a branch, merge or close the pull request, delete a comment, or start any other workflow.
Triage issues in discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; add and remove issue labels (creating a missing triage label), and post and edit my triage comments. Never delete or rename a label, delete a comment, close, assign, or retitle an issue, or push.
